title: HB 2492 (55th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session, 2022) — voter registration; verification; citizenship
operative_text:
Sec 1, 16-101 qualification: satisfactory evidence of citizenship: Is a citizen of the United States and has provided SATISFACTORY evidence of CITIZENSHIP as PRESCRIBED in section 16-166.
16-121.01(C),(E) application must include evidence; without it no presidential or mail early ballot: any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship
Sec 2 16-112 driver license registration: Every person who is applying for a driver license or renewal and who is otherwise qualified to register to vote shall
Sec 5 new 16-123 proof of location of residence: a person who registers to vote shall provide an identifying document that establishes proof of location of residence.
Sec 6 16-134 incomplete forms: shall notify the applicant within ten business days of receipt of the registration form
Sec 7 new 16-143 Attorney General review of unverified registrants: THE SECRETARY OF STATE AND EACH COUNTY RECORDER SHALL MAKE AVAILABLE TO THE ATTORNEY GENERAL A LIST OF ALL INDIVIDUALS
Sec 8 16-165 cancellation: When the county recorder receives and confirms information that the person registered is not a United States citizen.
Sec 4 16-121.01 presumption of proper registration: A person is presumed to be properly registered to vote on completion of a registration form
Sec 9 severability: If a provision of this act or its application to any person or circumstance is held invalid,
higher_law_duty: No citation of HAVA or NVRA found in fetched summary; duties imposed on county recorders and Secretary of State. Summary says recorders use SAVE database for federal-form applicants.
